hero-description:
	✝️ “Lord, renew my mind.
Remove every wrong mindset
and replace it with Your truth!”
	👤 Father, transform me completely.
Let my thoughts, words, and actions reflect Christ!
	🌍 I will not conform to the patterns of this world.
I will stand firm in righteousness!
	💧 Refresh my spirit today.
Pour new life and new passion into me!
	👁️ I will discern Your perfect will.
Guide my decisions according to Your good
and pleasing purpose!
	🙏 Revive my prayer life.
Draw me closer into fellowship with You
as I fast and seek Your face!
“This is my Time of Refreshing!”
